gen-gf-revalia-gf-krub: Krub keeps its sans lines tall and unhurried. Revalia earns its place in big, short headings, where its widely spaced letters and open-bellied g get room to strut.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-kufam: Expressive Revalia leans back with a loose, wide stride up top. Kufam follows in a plain sans of tube-like, even strokes, its big bodies and barely-there ascenders keeping the lines low and tidy.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-lexend: Lexend reads big and friendly, with oversized lowercase and curves that stay wide open. Revalia is best at loud, spaced-out display lines, while Lexend does its job quietly, keeping every stroke the same width around each turn.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-lexend-deca: Loud up top, mellow below. Revalia stretches out with a swaggering g, and Lexend Deca answers in a plain sans line with no hairlines and small capitals next to its big lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-liter: Showy on top, sturdy below. Revalia is best at bold, loosely spaced display lines, while Liter handles the quiet work with tall lowercase, wide round forms and no stroke contrast at all.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mada: Big personality, easygoing partner. Revalia is best when it can sprawl across a heading with its open-tailed g, and Mada does its best work underneath, with a towering midzone and curves left pleasantly unclosed.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads open and a little lofty, with generous curves and a high mean line. Revalia sits over it with a bold, spread-out swagger, and the sans-serif text keeps the page grounded without competing.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-matangi: Matangi presses its hefty lowercase out in ribbon-like strokes with rounded letters left open. Revalia's wide-striding display letters sit above it, giving the page a loud start and a sturdy follow-through.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro skims along with a high-waisted lowercase and a welcoming gap in its c. Revalia is best at bold, spaced-out headline moments, while the sans-serif text carries on smoothly with a line that never changes thickness.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-michroma: Expressive Revalia stretches out boldly, its g open at the bottom and its letters spread wide. Michroma sits beneath with tall-bodied lowercase and generous space around every letter.
